Name: Lumisteria Toddlers Like Parents - Alternative Children
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] pack adding option for children, including[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286] Ridgeside Village [/url]children, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url] children. It can be used as a complement to any CP pack, including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/405]Toddler Like Parents[/url].

What are the advantages of an AT pack ?
- It is compatible with any existing CP pack, so you can have both your favorite CP mod and this one
- It is easy to use (get scissors, use them on the children you want to change, and select the option you want), and also more visual
- It allows two children of the same gender to look different, great for multiplayer game : the children of other players can look different than yours now
- It has options for compat with other mods that may be great for the future !
- It allows me to provide some more custom options for toddlers

You can search a texture by keywords. Current keywords : Vanilla, Modded, RSV, ARS, and name of the character the texture is based on. To search a retexture for abigail, type "abigail", to search a texture for a Ridgeside Village character, you can search RSV or the name of the bachelor (for example, "Shiro").

Note :
My mod Toddler Like Parents had some options that aren't available in this one. In the future, i may add options in my CP mod to target this mod, but remember you can use both at the same time.
If you have a custom npc and want me to support their children, you can let me know (private message, comment, message on discord).
- For modding permission, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/897]this article[/url]. Ask me questions if needed.

Credits :
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village [/url]﻿for the permission !
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url]﻿ for the permission !

Thanks :
- Atravita helped me to test some options !
